notes.title: Update on Progress / Play test day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287767/30875684ef85d039340ec9e07bd6f59ee4441794.png[/img]

Hello Everyone,

We have been making huge progress on back end systems! 

We now have:

- Account Data Base
- Player Stats
- Basic matchmaking system
- Other improvements

We are looking to host a play test date this month to test the new matchmaking system!

Please join the discord for more info: 

https://discord.gg/weNv2Q5WWX 

Thanks,
- Ty (Zin)
